{ "item": { "id": "d59bb291-50d2-439f-b893-f0b916c75502", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Migration guide (v1 → v2)", "short_description": "Move an existing v1 integration to the v2 API: cursor pagination, webhooks, and the new error shape.", "body": "

Migration guide (v1 → v2) {{ds:component/chip|label=v1 retired|variant=danger}}

v1 reached end of life on 2026-08-01 alongside the webhooks GA changelog entry. This guide covers the three breaking changes you need to handle to move a v1 integration to v2.

1. Pagination: offset → cursor

v1 used page/per_page query parameters. v2 uses an opaque cursor and next_cursor — see Limits, quotas & errors for the exact envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v1/pipelines?page=2&per_page=20 + GET /v2/pipelines?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ}}

2. Status checks: polling → webhooks

v1 had no push notifications — you polled a pipeline's status endpoint. v2 replaces this with the Webhooks endpoint: subscribe to pipeline.completed and pipeline.failed instead of polling.

3. Error shape

v1 returned bare error strings. v2 wraps every error in an object with a stable code field. Update any error handling that matched on message text — see the error shape reference.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v1 is retired|body_html=

v1 endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 404s on /v1/* paths, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback.

}}

Still stuck?

Common migration issues are covered in Troubleshooting / FAQ.

", "version_token": "2230dd8d-a803-4063-9dd5-11f99338d9de", "created_at": "2026-08-22T00:43:50.076Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-22T00:44:09.772Z", "placement_id": "a700fa76-0974-4b88-adfa-0769c3791e81", "folder_id": "08088d6d-fe4a-4704-b265-9636d2cd750e", "file_name": "migration-guide-v1-to-v2" } }

{ "item": { "id": "c64225c6-90e5-473d-836a-e16642ed3d35", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Changelog", "short_description": "Recent changes to the Godzilla API and platform.", "body": "

Changelog

\n

Recent changes to the API and platform. For the full v1 → v2 history, see the Migration guide. Older entries live in Release notes archive.

\n\n{{ds:component/stat|value=v2|label=current API version|description=Introduced cursor pagination and webhooks in place of v1 polling.}}\n\n

2026-08-01 — Webhooks generally available

\n

The Webhooks endpoint is now generally available for all workspaces, with signed payload verification.

\n\n

2026-06-15 — Cursor pagination on all list endpoints

\n

Every list endpoint, including Pipelines, moved from offset to cursor pagination. See Limits, quotas & errors for the envelope shape.

\n\n{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Breaking change|body_html=

Offset-based page/per_page parameters were removed, not deprecated. Clients still passing them received a validation error starting this date.

}}\n\n

2026-05-02 — v2 API launched

\n

Full v2 launch. See the Migration guide for what changed from v1.

", "version_token": "bd2e75a8-f623-49aa-8065-df397120c17e", "created_at": "2026-08-22T00:43:54.897Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-22T00:44:09.693Z", "placement_id": "40df2022-7c30-4490-b568-f805911a16c0", "folder_id": "08088d6d-fe4a-4704-b265-9636d2cd750e", "file_name": "changelog" } }
